items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: Well, Teddy Buckner, uh, they had Teddy Buckner on trumpet.

ctx.x: Was he with Ory before Teddy Buckner? That's the man I'm talking about.

Teddy Buckner. Teddy Buckner is the man. Yeah. Well, Teddy Buckner, uh, they had Teddy Buckner on trumpet. Mm-hmm. And, um... Well, we can, I can look it up. Yeah. And I can't remember, but it's on the Verve label. Mm-hmm. And, um, I'll never forget, and we had a lady. They imported from Paris, France to sing Kid Ory's, uh, song, His Flavor. And she did it in both, um, French and English. Little that would have been. Yeah. And, um, I had to first sit down and write for her to get her keys right. And, um, the way…
I didn't wake this week, you see, the hotel guy to have a celebrity. He said we'd pay you even though you weren't here. So I stayed there until almost a year.
